answer: Each seat files a licence, a transmitter serial and site coordinates on a named ridge or mesa. The epoch seed names a ninety-second slot; the station keys a signed burst into it and three monitors log bearings. Those lines must cross within five hundred metres of the licensed point; a replay from a city flat misses it. Seats that share a licence or a site fold into one vote and forfeit an 80,000 POA bond. Licence, radio and lease run $4,000 a station, so a thousand clones owe $4 million before one attestation. The tail of a comet crosses a sky, yet every gram trails from one nucleus.
